## Awaiting triage first touch — this card is invisible to every queue query

`domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`. ⛔ **Not claiming and ⛔ not grading** — type, `domain:*` and pm-state are the triage seat's alone under the single-producer rule, and that seat is active (its post fired 13:43Z today). Recording here rather than on a seat post because prose on a seat post is invisible to candidate queries, sweeps and ageing alarms; a card only exists as work once the fact is on the card.

**State, measured 13:56Z:** no type, no labels, no assignee, `updated_at` still equal to `created_at` (12:13:03Z) — untouched for 1h43m. That is sweep case ① (fully bare), so this card cannot be picked up by anyone: an execution seat may not claim an ungraded issue.

### Why this one is worth a first touch ahead of the queue

The lane carries a standing maintainer order to **prioritise Bugs**. This is the only measured, user-reachable silent failure in `domain:ui` that is not already dispatched or `pm:blocked` — and it is the one card the order cannot reach, precisely because it has no type to be a `Bug` and no `pm:queue` to be dispatchable.

### The filer's core claim re-measured independently, on `origin/main` @ `c38162d7c`

I did not take the report on trust — the asymmetry is still present today:

```
action-bar.tsx:309       actionType: action.type,          <- the real action type is composed
action-button.tsx:148    type: schema.actionType || schema.type,   <- resolved
action-icon.tsx:99       type: schema.type,                <- NOT resolved; actionType dropped
```

So a bar-hosted `action:icon` hands the runner `type: 'action:icon'`, which binds no handler. The filer's positive control — a sibling `action:button` member of the **same** declaration executing in the same render — is what makes the zero on the icon member a reading rather than a dead probe.

**One scope correction to the card body.** It suggests checking `action:group` / `action:menu` for the same question. Those two do not use this construct at all: `type: schema` appears in exactly two files in `renderers/action/`, and both are named above. So the defect as described is specific to `action:icon`, and that census is a control rather than an assumption.

### What is needed

A first touch only — type, `domain:ui`, and a pm-state. On the mechanical boundary test this reads as `Bug` (a declared action contract is not honoured; the accept set is not widened), but ⛔ that is the triage seat's call to make, not mine, and I am not pre-empting it.

## Claim — `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat

PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q` (`os-support-ai`). Branch `claude/issue-6306-action-icon-type-resolution`. Labels `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` in the same stroke as the assign.

Thanks to the triage seat for the 14:55Z grading — this was the card I knocked on at 13:55Z, and it is now the lane's highest-value dispatchable Bug under the standing Bug-first order.

### Pre-dispatch gate — both steps run

**1. Full comment thread read.** Two comments, no maintainer ruling, no `Blocked-by:`, no prior claim. ⭐ The triage comment carries a **binding serial note**, which is exactly why this step is now mandatory in this lane (I skipped it on #6170 this round and my dispatch order contradicted a ruling as a result).

**2. Shadow check** across open issues — no sibling card covers this defect.

### The serial note, answered

Triage asked: *"the same overlay/action renderer family has in-flight family work under the 2026-08-25 one-authority ruling (#6329 queued this round, #6327/#6326 findings); name any overlap in the claim's serial-constraints line."*

**Measured — thematically related, file surfaces disjoint:**

| card | surface | overlap with this card |
|---|---|---|
| **#6329** | `packages/app-shell` (`ActionParam` declared twice) | ⛔ none — different package |
| **#6327 / #6326** | `packages/components/src/renderers/**overlay**/` | ⛔ none — this card is `renderers/**action**/`, and both are `finding`, not dispatchable |

**This card's surface:** `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx` (+ its coverage). ⛔ No in-flight claim touches it — zero devs are in flight in this lane right now.

### Premise re-verified on `origin/main` @ `194fae184` (current, not the ref the card was filed on)

```
action-bar.tsx:309       actionType: action.type,                    <- the real action type is composed
action-button.tsx:148    type: schema.actionType || schema.type,     <- resolved
action-icon.tsx:99       type: schema.type,                          <- NOT resolved; actionType dropped
```

The asymmetry is intact. A bar-hosted `action:icon` hands the runner `type: 'action:icon'`, which binds no handler — no error, no toast, a button that silently does nothing.

**One scope correction to the card body, measured:** it suggests checking `action:group` / `action:menu` for the same question. `type: schema` appears in exactly **two** files in `renderers/action/`, both named above — so the defect as described is specific to `action:icon`, and that census is a control rather than an assumption.

## PM review — **ACCEPT** (PR #6362, head `afb35717b`)

`domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`. Verified against the tree with a named ref, ⛔ not from the report.

### Verified myself

| claim | reading |
|---|---|
| the fix matches `action:button`'s resolution | ✅ `type: schema.actionType \|\| schema.type` — identical to `action-button.tsx:148` |
| `actionType` added to the props intersection | ✅ same reason it sits on `action:button`'s |
| the `\|\| schema.type` leg preserves the standalone surface | ✅ documented at the site, and pinned by a regression row that **refuses a fix written as `schema.actionType` alone** |
| **the census extension** | ✅ `action-group.tsx:249` and `action-menu.tsx:220` both spell `type: action.type` — from their **own member array**, ⛔ not from `schema` |

⭐ **That census is better than the one I dispatched.** I told the dev the defect was `action:icon`-only because `type: schema` appears in exactly two files. That is true but shallow: it does not explain *why* `action:group` / `action:menu` are safe. The dev's answer does — they compose from their own member array rather than receiving a host-renamed `schema`, so the rename that causes this bug never happens to them. Same conclusion, real mechanism.

### ⭐ Two false assumptions it caught in ITSELF — the first is the best find of the run

**1. A trap row that was passing for the wrong reason.** The row originally awaited the `api` handler **first**, so it timed out and **the trap's own assertion never evaluated**. Its words: *"the 'two-sided' claim was asserted, not measured."* Restructured to settle on either path and assert the trap first — it now fires observably (`expected vi.fn() to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times`) and fails in **22 ms instead of ~1000 ms**.

⛔ A timing-out row that never reaches its assertion is indistinguishable from a passing one in a summary line. Catching that in your own draft is exactly the discipline this lane is built on.

**2. A near-miss finding that would have been wrong.** A bare `eslint .` from the repo root *looks* like the gate and reports **89 errors across 74 files**. It is **not** the gate — `lint:root` deliberately ignores `packages/*/**`, so that invocation lints package sources under the wrong config. Reporting those 89 would have been a fabricated finding. ⭐ **An invocation that resembles the gate is not the gate.**

### T5 was measured, not argued

I asked whether `check:action-forward-parity` could see this. The dev **ran it against the unfixed file**: identical output, including `action:icon owes 25, forwards 19, payload excess-property CHECKED`, and **exit 0**. That is a demonstration of blindness rather than a claim of it — `type` **is** in the forward whitelist and the gate diffs key *presence*; this is a wrong-*value* defect behind a present key.

It also sketched how the gate could be taught (a per-key value contract for host-renamed keys, `action-bar.tsx` being the single composer of that rename repo-wide) and ⛔ **did not modify the gate** — correct, that is `domain:devx` territory. Reported as an observation with its own false-positive surface named.

### Honest gate reporting

`pnpm lint` repo-wide hit the container's ~10-minute foreground cap and was SIGTERM'd (exit 143). Reported as **NOT MEASURED**, ⛔ not as red — with what *was* established: 46 of 47 tasks completed first, `@object-ui/components:lint` among them at **0 errors**, and the one task cut off (`app-shell`) is untouched by this diff. The 12 warnings on `action-icon.tsx` were **measured against the base file** — 12 before, 12 after, delta 0 — rather than assumed.

### Landing

CI: **15 success, 3 skipped, 0 failed, 9 running.** ⛔ `in_progress` is not a verdict. The PR reads `behind`; ⛔ not syncing — six PRs this round resolved that on their own.
